workshoptitle: Try What's New in Oracle AI Database 26ai: The Silverleaf Hustle

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Introduction to the Silverleaf Casino workshop on Oracle AI Database 26ai

tutorials.title: Get Started with LiveLabs
tutorials.description: Open your Autonomous AI Database and the SQL worksheet as ADMIN

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build the Casino Floor with Domains, Annotations and Assertions
tutorials.description: Build the casino schema with data use case domains, mark sensitive columns with annotations, and enforce a floor rule with an assertion.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Serve the Casino App with JSON Relational Duality Views
tutorials.description: Read and write the casino app's JSON documents through duality views, with the same rules enforced.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Uncover the Collusion Ring with Property Graphs
tutorials.description: Find the collusion ring with SQL property graphs and graph algorithms, then record the case.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Search the Surveillance Log with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Load an embedding model into the database and search the floor staff's notes by meaning.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Protect the Evidence with Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Create end users, data roles and data grants so each person sees only what they should.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: (Bonus) New SQL Features
tutorials.description: Try JOIN TO ONE, aggregation filters, QUALIFY, DATEDIFF and DATEADD on the casino data.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: (Bonus) Connect an AI Agent with the SQLcl MCP Server
tutorials.description: Connect an AI agent in VS Code to the casino database as Nina and as Vera, and watch the data grants decide what it sees.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Template to link to Need Help lab at the end of workshop. Change 'CHANGE-ME' in link below to need-help-livelabs.md or need-help-freetier.md
